version.author: kallums
version.changelog: First release through ReaPack. Plays your CC curves for you: play a note and it draws the arc - a rise, a sustain and a fall - across up to seven CC lanes at once, shaped like the real instrument family, so orchestral libraries can be played with both hands on the keys.

metadata.description: {\pard AutoCC\par A JSFX that watches incoming MIDI notes and draws orchestral controller curves automatically, across up to seven CC lanes at once.\par Put it before your sample library in the FX chain, so the library receives the CCs it makes.\par }
